title: Distinguish capital from recurrent costs with a lifecycle cost framework
requirements:
- Present DPI-H as needing capital and protected recurrent expenditure
- Extend the financing mandate to total cost of ownership, cost transparency and technical debt
- Cover cost, ownership, staffing, licensing, migration and supplier exit
- Capture funding source, end date, recurrent cost, contract, licence and exit conditions
- Warn against omitting long-term O&M costs and clarify relationship to the Digital Implementation Investment Guide
- Itemise recurrent costs, including trust operations, terminology maintenance and support
- Link reserves and contingency to component criticality
- Reference costing methods or tools for total cost of ownership
